scope: Owned loopback stand, synthetic member identity; actual upload/parser/read/UI. No provider or hosted claim.
checks: Upload directly places one file icon with no app/source-registration request.
A single click selects the file without opening it.
All105 logical rows/all32 columns and whitespace/multiline/leading-zero cells are available; markup stays text; raw CSV and download preserve original bytes.
Enter and Space open the original; Escape closes and returns focus.
Dragging away and back to the starting point does not open the viewer.
Reload restores the file from authorized metadata; browser storage contains scoped references/positions, no filenames or cells.
Late actual table responses cannot overwrite a newer raw view or remount a closed dialog.
Workbook selection exposes both original worksheets and exact large/exponent lexical values.
A formula-bearing workbook stays a file; refusal explains limits and retains original download, without fabricated/sample cells.
390px and320px: restored file icon and modal remain in viewport; pagination and close are reachable.
Keyboard removal removes only the placement and does not open a viewer or delete the original.
